# Cross-references and equations {#sec-g-crossrefs}

Every figure, table, section, and equation that is referred to gets a label. Quarto numbers them and turns each reference into a link.

## Label prefixes {#sec-g-crossrefs-prefixes}

| Prefix | Used for | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `sec-` | Sections and chapters | `sec-quality-depth` |
| `fig-` | Figures | `fig-quality-depth` |
| `tbl-` | Tables | `tbl-results-counts` |
| `eq-` | Equations | `eq-lfc` |

: Label prefixes and what each is for. {#tbl-g-crossrefs-prefixes}

@tbl-g-crossrefs-prefixes lists the prefixes. Section labels follow `sec-<chapter>-<topic>`, so a label says where it lives. Labels are unique across the whole book. The caption check enforces this.

````markdown
## Depth per sample {#sec-quality-depth}

See @sec-quality-depth and @tbl-results-counts.
````

## Equations {#sec-g-crossrefs-equations}

The log2 fold change compares the mean log2 CPM of the treated group, $\bar{x}_T$, with that of the control group, $\bar{x}_C$. Each value is $\log_2(\mathrm{CPM} + 1)$, so the difference of means is the log of a ratio of geometric means:

$$
\mathrm{LFC} = \bar{x}_T - \bar{x}_C
$$ {#eq-lfc}

The Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value for the feature ranked $i$ of $m$, with p-values sorted in ascending order, is:

$$
q_{(i)} = \min_{j \ge i} \left( \min\left(1, \frac{m}{j}\, p_{(j)}\right) \right)
$$ {#eq-bh}

@eq-lfc defines the fold change used in every volcano plot. @eq-bh defines the FDR column in every results table.

````markdown
$$
\mathrm{LFC} = \log_2 \frac{\bar{x}_T}{\bar{x}_C}
$$ {#eq-lfc}

@eq-lfc defines the fold change.
````

## The linking rule {#sec-g-crossrefs-rule}

Every limitation and every interpretation item cites the section it came from. A reader must be able to follow any claim back to the measurement in one click. See @sec-limitations for the gathered limitations.
